title: query --concept
summary: Ranked BM25 concept search over identifier words and doc-comment prose
intro: Read this when you know what the code does but not what it is called. It ranks symbols by how well their camelCase-split name and their doc-comment summary and remarks match your words, best first, with no re-parse needed to enable it.
pitfalls: approximate matched column: first 5 letters of a word stand in for porter stemming.
no synonyms and no embeddings: remove does not find delete.
exit 3 = this index has no concept-search table yet; run index once (backfills from existing rows, no re-parse).

questions.ask: Which code does something like this, when I do not know the name?
How do I restrict concept search to classes?
